test_title: SSC CGL 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On : 09 Dec 2022 Shift 4)
subject: general
question:
**Select the most appropriate synonym of the underlined word in the given sentence.**

The director is at the __apex__ of the managing committee.
solution: The correct answer is option 4), i.e., 'Pinnacle.' [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** • Let's look at the meanings of the given word and marked option: • Apex- the highest point or pinnacle. (सर्वोच्च, शीर्षबिंदु) • Pinnacle- the most successful point; the highest point. (शिखर, सर्वोच्च) • ​Let's look at the meanings of the other given options:​ • Core- the central or most important part of something. (मूल, आन्तरक, अन्तर्भाग) • Bottom- the lowest point or part of something. (तल, तह, तली, निचला भाग) • Corner- a place or angle where two or more sides or edges meet. (कोना) • The sentence talks about a director who holds a **high position** in a managing committee. • Clearly, the word 'Pinnacle' is closest in meaning to the given word 'Apex.' • Therefore, the correct synonym of the given word is option 4. 1d1:Tad73,
